recordDecisions.boundedClaim: For every number field K, the current owner source reports that its Dedekind zeta function has no zeros in Re(s)>31/32, excluding the pole s=1. It also reports the same half-plane for finite-order Hecke L-functions represented by ray class characters with nonzero modulus; s=1 is included for nonprincipal characters, whose continuations are entire. The compared statements identify the continuations with the Dedekind zeta function or ideal Dirichlet series in Re(s)>1. This is not the full generalized Riemann hypothesis.
